intro: Who can see this space's challenges, categories, announcements and materials. Opening a space needs platform review, and the current setting stays until it is approved; going back to members only takes effect at once.
membersHint: Only admins and members can see this space
openHint: Signed-in users whose registered email is in scope can see it, claim and publish challenges without joining; admins add people outside the scope on the Members page
pending: Open request under review: {scope}. The space keeps its current setting until it is approved
scopeRequired: Enter at least one email suffix
